title: Grand Theft Chog
description:
Rob a rival gang's vault while its members jump in live and steer the guards against you, then run the bag home through a city full of real holders.

Grand Theft Chog is a live city at night where every Chog Genesis holder walks the streets as their own Chog, at the same time. Your Chog's traits decide which gang it can rep (20 gangs, each with its own building, vault, walk and lock), and gangs rob each other's vaults.

A robbery has three stages:

1. Break in. Every gang's door has its own lock: pick the pins, cut the alarm wires in order, stop the slot reels on the gang's building, or turn the safe dial. Slip more than once and the alarm goes off.
2. The vault. Grab the cash and crack the safe while the gang's guards hunt you. The guards are that gang's own Chogs. Your Chog's traits are its powers: laser eyes, the cardboard box, a blink, a coin toss to distract the guards and more.
3. The run home. Out of the vault with the bag, you have to carry it through the live city to your own gang's door, with police on foot and siren cars after you, while everyone online watches. Members of the gang you robbed can run you down themselves.

Get home and the cash lands in your gang's vault. Get caught and it goes back, your gang pays a fine, and your Chog sits in the city jail, where a gang-mate can break you out.

What makes it new:

- Every holder is in one city at once. Raids are live: the robbed gang can jump into its own vault and steer a guard against you, and anyone can watch.
- The record belongs to the NFT token. Cash stolen, escapes, busts and catches stay with the Chog when it's sold.
- Every robbery has a replay, from the break-in to the run home, made from the moves the server checked. Share the link and anyone can watch it.
- $CHOG is burned from your own wallet for bail (30), a Wanted poster on a rival (60: an extra officer on its getaways and a bounty on it) and a gang banner over your building (150). The plaza's big screen counts every $CHOG burned.
- The Chog Telegram bot posts the biggest robberies and a daily recap ("Yesterday in Grand Theft Chog") to the community.
- Judging week has events: a Left trait vs Right trait chogs election (24�26 Oct) where every bag carried home scores for your Chog's Side trait, and Halloween week (27�31 Oct) when the city is haunted, Skulls and Radioactive take more, and every haul counts double on the 31st.
- It works great on both phone and PC: a thumb stick, big buttons and a map you can pinch on a phone, and the keyboard on a PC.

Why the Chog NFT is essential:

Take the NFT out and there's no game. Your Chog is your character: its picture is the piece you move and the face everyone sees. Its traits pick its gang, its walk and its powers. The guards in a gang's vault are that gang's Chogs. The record is kept on the token, so it moves with the Chog when it changes hands. Ownership is read from the Chog Genesis contract and followed live, so a Chog sold walks out of your wallet and into the buyer's with all its records.

How it stays fair: the vault plays the same way every time from each run's seed, your phone sends only your key presses, and the server replays them to find what really happened. The run home is refereed by the live server, which signs the result. $CHOG burns are read from Monad and counted once. More: https://grandtheftchog.duckdns.org/fair

PHONE COMPANION

title: The Chog World
description:
Chog World is a pixel-art MMORPG on Monad where your Chog Genesis NFT is your character. Connect your wallet, sign a free login message, pick one of your Chogs and step into a living town shared in real time with every other holder: walk, work, trade, build, gamble and hang out together.

YOUR NFT, PLAYABLE
Every Chog Genesis piece is playable with its own look: classic Chogs, Skulls, Radioactives and the 1:1s, each with hand-drawn walk animations in four directions. Traits are not just cosmetic, they shape how you play:
- Laser eyes you can switch on to zap the Chogs in front of you.
- Creatures of the night (Skulls, Radioactives) that never get tired after dark.
- Chogs that can walk on water, crowned Chogs that can take the Mystery Crown, Chog-themed traits that open Chog chests.
- "Plumber" Chogs that can be hired in restaurants, "Left" sided Chogs that can deal at the roulette.
- Coin holders who unlock the high-roller bets at the casino.
1:1s can do everything. Rarer pieces and $CHOG holdings also boost the XP you earn, and you can switch between your Chogs at any time.

A TOWN THAT RUNS ON ITS PLAYERS
- Gather wood, crops and fish, complete daily quests and level up to unlock new perks.
- Sell your goods on market stalls to other players at your own prices.
- Buy land, build a house, furnish it and choose who can come in.
- Own and run a business: the restaurant has stock, preparation stations, a menu, tables to serve and staff hired through an in-game job board with real payroll.
- Buy a car, park it anywhere and drive around town.
- Make friends, chat, rate other players and build a reputation.

THE CASINO
The casino is the beating heart of the town, and it is run by players, not by a script.

Roulette with real dealers. Every roulette table needs a dealer, and the dealer is a player: only Chogs with the "Left" side trait can be hired for the job. The dealer opens the table, calls "no more bets" and spins the wheel. Several players sit at the same table, place their chips on the same layout during the betting time, watch the same spin and get paid at the same moment. The house edge goes to the casino as a business, so dealing is a real job in the town's economy. High-roller chips are reserved for Coin holders.

Slot machines. Classic slots with a ladder of bets, the biggest ones reserved for Coin holders.

Trading floor. The casino has trading PCs that open a full-screen retro desktop with live candlestick charts, zoom and pan, a feed of every trade, open positions and leaderboards. Players go long or short with up to 50x leverage, set their margin, and close in profit or get liquidated.

What makes it unique is what you trade and what moves the price:
- The markets come from the collection itself. Besides $CHOG, BTC and MON, every token is themed on a Chog Genesis trait family: $RETARD, $MANGA, $HORNY, $BUBBLE, $PEACE, $SEA, $GOLD, $CLOWN. Your traits are your trading licence: a Chog with a Gold Tooth or Golden Armor unlocks $GOLD, a Duck Float or Shark Suit unlocks $SEA, a Clown nose unlocks $CLOWN, and so on. Any piece in your wallet counts, not only the one you play. $CHOG is open to everyone, and 1:1s and Candle Chogs unlock every market.
- The price is made by the players. $CHOG, BTC and MON start from their real market price, then live their own life inside the game. Every position a player opens or closes pushes the price, like on a real automated market: deep markets move slowly, small trait tokens move a lot, which makes them the playground of the degens. A light background noise keeps charts alive when nobody trades, but the big moves are always the players. When the price runs, over-leveraged positions get liquidated in cascade and the move feeds itself.
- Candle Chogs play their side of the market: a Green Candle gets +15% on long gains and 15% softer losses, a Red Candle the same on shorts, within a daily cap.
- Players can launch their own token. For 100,000 MX (burned), anyone can list a new ticker with its own name and color. It gets its own market, chart and trade feed, open to every trader in town. Trading fees are burned too, which keeps the in-game economy healthy.

LIVE EVENTS
A day and night cycle, the Mystery Crown hunt, Chog chests hidden around the map, a daily wheel of fortune, double-XP weeks, leaderboards and an in-game radio. Players without a Chog can still enter as spectators, follow any player around town, even inside buildings, and see the world before they join.

BUILT FOR REAL PLAY
Chog World is a real-time, server-authoritative game: every action, bet and trade is validated by the server, so nobody can cheat their balance or their position. Wallet ownership is proven with Sign-In with Ethereum: no transaction, no gas, no token approval, the game only ever reads the chain. One wallet plays in one place at a time.

COMING NEXT
Two features are already planned and on their way:
- $CHOG into $MX. Players will be able to convert $CHOG into $MX, the in-game currency, to buy skins, cars, houses and items. The conversion is one-way, like V-Bucks: $MX never converts back to $CHOG, which keeps the game economy closed and gives $CHOG a real, recurring use inside the game. The conversion screen is already in the game; the on-chain transfer to a game vault verified by the server is the next step.
- Partner collections. Other Monad NFT collections will join the world as playable characters, drawn in the game's style, with their own traits turned into perks and their own trait tokens on the trading floor. Their holders share the same town and the same economy, and since $CHOG is the way into that economy, every new community brings new demand and new liquidity to $CHOG.

- The first live Bell rang on Oct 21 and settled on Oct 22 at 15:11 UTC: $CHOG moved -1.69%, and Velvet Whiskers (token 873) called -1.7% to become the first Oracle of the Day.

REAL VS SIMULATED (EVERYTHING IS LABELLED)

Real: the NFTs, traits and art; the ERC-6551 wallets and balances; hourly CHOG/WMON candles and Bell settlement prices; 0G AI calls and receipts; the heist's mainnet check (read-only); guarded trades; trophies; Oracle Purse transfers.

Points have no cash value and are never a wager. 14 trait values get display-friendly names wherever they become text, including AI prompts. Holders can hide their Chog with one free signature. No AI-generated Chog art.

USAGE SO FAR (live at https://useanimr.vercel.app/stats, Oct 23)

2 live Bells, 1 settled, 1 Oracle Purse paid (500 $CHOG), 2 trophies minted. 30 AI decisions stored, 27 of them from the LLM on 0G Compute, for $0.08 in total. 4 heist attempts, 3 Versus picks. The counters are real and start at our launch on Oct 21.

PRE-EXISTING WORK

We built on: the create-next-app scaffold; ERC-6551 registry v0.3.1 and Tokenbound V3, as deployed; Uniswap v3 FullMath, TickMath and OracleLibrary, vendored with their licenses; forge-std and open-source npm packages; the Chog Genesis IPFS metadata; GeckoTerminal, DexScreener and OpenSea APIs.

Built for Chogathon 2026.

title: ChogSwipe
description:
Chogswipe is a Spy vs Spy-style heist game for Chog holders on Monad. Connect a wallet holding a Chog and its NFT traits become its gadgets: eyes scout for traps, hats pick locks, bodies set your speed, accessories are one-shot specials, and rarity sets how strong they are.
Every holder runs a hideout. Pick a floor plan, hide traps, and stake $CHOG in your onchain vault. Then raid other holders: sneak past guards and traps, swipe up to 10% of their vault, and get back out the front door before the clock runs out.
Defending pays. Every raider puts up a ticket from their own stake when the raid opens. Catch them and the ticket is yours. Every staked hideout also earns a share of 5% of every successful swipe in the game, and claiming it compounds it into the vault.
Every raid is replayed by the referee server and settled on Monad. Raided hideouts get a shield, and owners can watch replays of every raid on them. Between raids, holders warm up on 7 lore heists with their own layouts, plus a daily heist with a leaderboard.

No Chog yet? Try the first two heists with a sample Chog, no wallet needed.

title: VIBER BRAWL
description:
CHOG TRIALS is a playable 3D boss fight that lives inside VIBER BRAWL, my browser arena
brawler. You are a Chog. Your opponent is a haunted CHOG MART vending machine that has
decided it does not want to sell you anything.

No download, no login, no wallet to play the build � it opens in the browser in about
two seconds.

THE FIGHT
Three phases, 420 HP of machine, five telegraphed attacks � TILT, LUNGE, DISPENSE,
COINS, SHARDS � and one idea the whole fight is built around: the machine's own vents
are the only way to hurt it properly. Stay close and it overheats. When it does, you
climb onto its back and ride it, punching down through the vent grille for 55 damage
and a stagger. Everything else is a distraction.

Your health is the stock on the shelf. Every can you lose is a hit you took.

WHAT'S IN THE BUILD
� A real 3D tutorial � 12 scripted performances on a second renderer, using the actual
  boss model. Not slides.
� Intro, win and lose cinematics, all in-engine.
� A convenience-store alley built from ~415 meshes at 60fps: instanced brickwork, a
  night sky, a city skyline, a shopping cart you can get wedged behind.
� Pause, rematch, and both keyboard/mouse and full touch controls (analog stick, hold
  buttons, tap-to-attack, orientation lock).

HOW IT WAS MADE
One file. Three.js r128, hand-written geometry, canvas-generated textures, and a Web
Audio synth that builds every sound effect at runtime � no asset downloads at all. The
fight was balanced by measurement rather than feel: I wrote a bot that plays the game
headlessly and ran it hundreds of times, tuning boss HP, cooldowns and attack pools
until a competent player wins in 18-20 seconds with 30-60 HP left, and a passive one
dies in 15.

THE CHOG PART
Holding a qualifying Chog NFT unlocks the Chog fighter and Chog Trials from the main
menu. Without it, Viber Brawl stays fully playable and the mode stays locked. In this
submission build the gate is open so judges can walk straight in � wallet verification
is the next milestone, and the menu already carries the holder state.

Built solo in four weeks.

title: Chog League
description:
Chog League turns your Chog into a trading account with a record you can prove.

Pick a market (BTC, ETH, SOL or MON), call HIGHER or LOWER over 1 to 5 minutes, set your stake and a payout multiplier, and watch the live price. Every call settles on real Coinbase prices, at the close of the 1-minute candle when it expires. Trading uses demo money, so a bad call never costs real funds.

What's new: skill you can prove, saved on the NFT

- Fair at every multiplier. The target price is set from each market's recent volatility, so your chance of winning is about 1 in (1 + multiplier). 1x is a coin flip, 5x is 1 in 6. No setting is a better deal than another; only your reads are.

- Level = wins minus losses. Because the odds are fair, luck cancels out over time, so a Chog's level is a skill score. Higher levels unlock bigger multipliers, from 1.5x at Level 1 (Rookie) to 5x at Level 5 (Legend, 50 net wins).

- Everything is saved to the Chog's token ID, never the wallet. Level, record, weekly crowns and cosmetics travel with the NFT. Sell your Chog and the buyer gets a proven trader. That is a new kind of NFT value: a track record.

WHY THE CHOG IS ESSENTIAL

- The Chog IS the account. League play, levels, duels for the league and the crown only exist for a Chog, and only its owner can play it: ownership is re-checked on Monad (ownerOf) before every trade.

- No two Chogs play the same. Each one's traits decide its gameplay: its Background gives it a home market (+1x multiplier there), and its Eyes give it one daily power: Shield (a loss doesn't drop its level), Double Up (a win counts twice) or Parachute (half the risk, half the profit). All of them keep the odds fair, so rare Chogs don't win automatically.

- The Chog reacts on its picture: it bounces with confetti on a win, shakes and greys out on a loss, burns on a hot streak, frosts on a cold one, and wears a crown as the league's number one.

Anyone can try it in Practice mode with any Chog and no wallet. Practice never counts toward records or the league.


THREE WAYS TO PLAY

- Calls: quick higher-or-lower trades, up to 5 open at once. Want out early? Cash out any live call for what it's worth right now (its chance of winning � what it pays, minus a 2% exit fee); a cash-out counts as neither a win nor a loss, so levels stay honest.

- Duels, Chog vs Chog: see who's online and challenge them. Quick duels and best of 3 or 5 use hidden picks with a 20-second window; Arenas run 15 minutes, 1 hour or 24 hours with a $1,000 bankroll each. Both sides put in the same demo stake and the winner takes the pot. Practice players can duel a bot.

- Weekly league: every Monday at 00:00 UTC every Chog restarts with $1,000 demo. The highest balance at the reset wins the crown, a real $CHOG prize and a place in the Hall of Champions. Daily streaks and daily power recharges bring players back every day.

A weekly practice board too: anyone playing without a wallet is ranked by practice balance, just for fun. The real $CHOG prize stays with Chog holders in the league.


EASY TO START, FUN TO WATCH

- Know what to do from the first second: a 47-second "How to play" clip on the home page, then a step-by-step guide that lights up each control in turn and walks a new player through their first call (market, time, amount, multiplier, power, Higher or Lower).

- A chart you can feel: your Chog's picture rides the live price, glowing green when you're winning and red when you're not. Your win zone is shaded, your entry and target are marked, and a ?? finish flag counts down. A strip under the chart says "winning!" or "needs +$12.40 higher". A "LIVE � Prices by Coinbase" badge shows the prices are real.

- Share cards: every finished call makes an image of your Chog with a stamp (WIN or REKT), a funny line ("Got rekt.", "Called it.", "Paper hands, paper money.") and the result, ready to share, save or post on X. The server builds it from the saved trade, so nobody can fake a big win.

- History on every Chog: every call and duel it has played, with hit rate, net result, best win, worst loss and favourite market, filters, and each duel's opponent and score. The league history belongs to the token, so anyone can check a Chog's record, including someone about to buy it.


$CHOG integration

- Shop: titles (250 $CHOG), profile frames (500) and victory animations (1,000). Looks only, never an advantage, and saved to the Chog so they go with it when it's sold. Anyone can try items on for free.

- Payments are checked on-chain: the buyer sends $CHOG from their wallet, and the server reads the Transfer on Monad (sender, receiver, amount) before handing over the item. Each payment counts once.

- Every sale grows the prize: the weekly prize starts at 2,000 $CHOG, plus 70% of that week's shop sales; the other 30% is burned. Payments and burns are linked in the Hall of Champions ("Paid ?", "burned ?") so anyone can check them.

- Chip in: anyone can add $CHOG to this week's prize; all of it goes to the winner.

- Tip the champion: $CHOG goes straight from the tipper to the reigning champion's owner.

- Holders: wallets with 10,000+ $CHOG get a ?? holder badge on their Chogs and 20% off in the shop.

Trading and duels never use real money: $CHOG rewards play and is never gambled.


UNDER THE HOOD

Next.js 15 (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind), wagmi + viem with a browser wallet, Monad mainnet (Chog Genesis NFT and the $CHOG token), Supabase for records, and Coinbase's public API for live prices.

Sign-in is a free signed message; no transaction is needed to play. Built solo during Chogathon.

No pre-existing code; and the Chog art and traits come from the collection's own metadata.


FEEDBACK AND USAGE

Since launch on Oct 14: 14 players (counted by browser) made 45 finished calls on 22 different Chogs and played 11 duels, tracked live at chog-league.vercel.app/api/stats.

We shared the live app with builders and Chog holders and shipped their feedback the same day:

- "Once I land, I should know what to do next" ? the "How to play" clip on the home page.

- "I barely know what to click next, hold my hand" ? the step-by-step guide for a first call.

- "Are the live prices real? Show who provides them" ? the "LIVE � Prices by Coinbase" badge.

- "The charts look very basic, gamify the chart" ? win zone, finish flag, the Chog riding the price and the winning / needs-$X strip.

- "Let me generate a PnL card with a funny line, like Chog got rekt" ? share cards for every call.

- "Why can't I close a position early?" ?  Cash out, at a fair price, with a "Take $X now?" check. Two testers asked for it, so it shipped.

- A way to look back at past trades and duels ? History on every Chog.


WHAT'S NEXT

- Publish each Chog's record on-chain, so marketplaces and other apps can show a Chog's level and crowns next to its price.

- Seasons: monthly championships across the weekly leagues, with bigger $CHOG prizes.

- More shop items, including duel arena themes, and community-designed cosmetics.

- More markets, and tournaments run with the Chog community.

title: ChogWorks
description:
ChogWorks turns community participation into shared rewards and gives Chog Genesis NFTs a practical role beyond a profile picture.

Advertisers create funded campaigns for actions on X, Discord, Telegram, or websites. Users complete quests, earn points, and receive a proportional share of the weekly reward pool.

Campaign funds are split into 80% reward escrow, 10% team fees, and 10% sent to a burn address. Only the portion corresponding to completed tasks contributes to rewards; unused escrow can be refunded when the creator closes and settles a campaign.

Chog Genesis holders unlock an upgradeable points miner. Mining and daily check-in bonuses together contribute no more than 20% of a user's quest points to their reward score, keeping completed work at the center of the economy.

Users sign in with Google or email and receive an embedded wallet. CHOG ownership is checked on Monad. Holders can prove control through a small MON transfer to their own embedded wallet, including supported internal transfers, without connecting their NFT wallet to the site.

The MVP includes campaign creation, quest completion, daily streaks, holder verification, mining, upgrades, a weekly leaderboard, campaign settlement and refunds, and smart-contract reward claims.

Current demo:
� Payments and rewards use test $WORK on Robinhood Chain Testnet.
� The planned production token is $CHOG.
� Social profiles are entered manually. Social API verification is not integrated yet; test completions are credited after the Go/Verify cooldown and remain subject to manual spot checks.
� Weekly distributions are published by the admin after settlement; users claim their rewards onchain.
� Transfers to the burn address do not reduce ERC20 totalSupply.

Built for Chogathon as a working testnet MVP.

title: Game of Chogs
description:
Game of Chogs is a Game of Thrones parody where every one of the 1,969 Chog Genesis NFTs is a scheming noble in one shared realm on Monad. You get 3 gas a day to stab, duel, propose, feast, bend the knee or beget heirs. Every move resolves on the spot with a comic explosion. Win and a title like Kingslayer is stamped on your Chog. Fail and you do the walk of shame while the whole realm hears the bell.

Every midnight UTC the richest Chog is crowned on the Iron Toilet. The Raven, a gossip paper, prints the day's stabbings, weddings and betrayals, and the state of the realm is sealed on-chain.

What's new: the NFT isn't a profile picture you show off. It's a living character with a political career. Its record (titles, scars, spouse, liege, heirs, grudges) belongs to the token, so a Chog's history follows it across sales. Unclaimed Chogs are played by simple rule-based bots, so the realm is busy from day one, and you come back to "you were stabbed 4 times while you slept". There are no LLMs: the Raven is stitched from over 400 hand-written comedy lines.

Remove the Chog NFT and there is no game: no noble, no stats, no House, no save file and no portrait.

- Key: only the wallet that ownerOf(tokenId) returns right now can play that noble. Ownership is checked live on every move, so a sold Chog stops obeying its old lord at once.
- Stats from traits: Cunning comes from Eyes and Accessory, Might from Body and Base, Charm from Head and Mouth, plus a Tier bonus. The Background trait picks the House.
- State container: clout, titles, scars, spouse, liege and heirs are keyed by the token, not the wallet, and sealed every day to the ChogLedger contract on Monad.
- Transferable identity: sell your Chog and the buyer inherits its enemies, spouse, heirs, titles and throne claim.
- NFTs make NFTs: married Chogs can beget a Chogling, a real ERC-721 heir that records both parents on-chain. Players without a Chog can claim a free bastard NFT, minted gaslessly.

title: CHOG : ROOM ZERO
description:
CHOG: ROOM ZERO is a tactical multiplayer shooter built around one idea: information is a resource.

Players move through dark, tense environments where hearing an enemy, choosing when to peek, reading movement, and deciding when to engage can matter more than simply having better aim.

The game supports solo play, 1v1 duels, 3v3 fights, and 5v5 holder gameplay. Players can creep around corners, track enemies through sound, fight, reload, use abilities, and make decisions with incomplete information.

But the biggest differentiator is CHOG integration.

CHOG isn't just a collectible sitting beside the game. Its traits are integrated directly into gameplay. Traits such as Laser Eyes, Visor, Bubblegum, Drooling and Aura map to actual abilities, with rarity affecting properties such as range, duration and cooldown. Every ability is designed around readable telegraphs and counters, making the CHOG itself part of how you play.

The result is a multiplayer game where your CHOG can actually change the way you approach a fight.

We built ROOM ZERO to make information, positioning and identity matter.

title: Chog Foundry
description:
Chog Foundry is an NFT-powered token launch and community platform built on Monad. It gives Chog Genesis NFTs a new role: each NFT becomes a studio where its owner can build an identity, develop ideas, launch tokens, and bring a community together.
Studio owners can personalize their profiles and launch fixed-supply tokens traded in CHOG. Each token starts on a bonding curve, with a path to Uniswap v4 liquidity when graduation conditions are met. The trading terminal brings together live charts, market cap, transactions, holder information, and buy/sell functionality.
Beyond launching and trading, Chog Foundry gives each studio a place to grow. Studio clubs support public conversations, announcements, and token discussions, while the Foundry Assistant helps users explore concepts, plan launches, and understand relevant studio information. Community campaigns offer participation tasks and points that can be used to enter published NFT raffles. Each raffle includes its prize details, entry requirements, and closing time, with an onchain draw to select the winner.
Studios remain connected to their NFTs. When a Chog changes hands, studio control and future studio fees pass to the new owner, while its launches and community history remain attached to the studio. Previously earned fee credits stay with the wallets that earned them.
A public treasury page provides visibility into recorded platform fees, published allocations, and NFT custody. Treasury funds can be allocated toward buying back Chog NFTs from the market and making them available as prizes for future community raffles. These purchases are managed through published budgets and recorded transactions rather than automatic buybacks.
Together, these features make Chog Foundry a home for both the initial idea and the community that develops around it.

title: The Chog of Wall Street (COWS)
description:
The Chog of Wall Street turns every Chog NFT into an on-chain business. Each Chog opens an account with $20 of USDC, buys shares of streets in a shared city economy, and earns rent whenever other Chogs pass through. It can also borrow against its holdings, trade them at auction, stake MON through FastLane, aPriori and Kintsu, and earn yield in Morpho's USDC vault. Everything it owns lives inside the NFT itself, so a Chog is no longer just a picture: it's a portfolio with cash flow, and selling the Chog sells the whole business with it.

Under the hood it's a closed, zero-sum economy on Monad. Nothing is minted, every dollar comes from a player, and the contract proves its books balance. Rules like equal $20 starts, a 48-hour activity requirement and weekly prizes for growth rather than size reward active players over idle whales. $CHOG is the economy's utility token: power-ups are paid in it and burned, and a share of every fee buys $CHOG back on nad.fun and burns it, so every action in the city creates real demand for $CHOG and real traffic for Monad apps.

title: Chogland
description:
ChogLand is a land-war strategy game where every Chog NFT is a soldier.

All players share one territory map of 160 land tiles. Your Chogs claim empty land, attack rival tiles and defend their own. Every Chog fights for a guild picked by its NFT traits, so the art you hold decides your team. Guilds push their borders tile by tile toward the 4 gold core tiles in the middle. The guild holding the most core tiles at the end of each week wins the $CHOG war pot.

WHY THE CHOG NFT IS ESSENTIAL
Take the NFT out and the game stops working.
- No Chog, no play. Every unit on the map is a Chog the player owns, checked on-chain on every move.
- The Chog's traits decide its guild and its power, so two Chogs never play the same way.
- Each Chog keeps its XP, wins and season badges forever. When it is sold, the buyer gets the veteran with its full record, so a Chog that plays well is worth more.
- A holder with Chogs in different guilds plays all of them, so every extra Chog adds energy, tiles and ways to win.

HOW A BATTLE WORKS
- Attack = Chog power x 3, plus a team bonus when allies hit the same tile.
- Defense = holder power + 3 per shield (max 5) + a core bonus.
- Win chance = attack / (attack + defense), kept between 10% and 90%.
- The roll comes from a daily seed. Its hash is published before play and the seed is revealed at 00:00 UTC, so anyone can recheck every battle.
- A win flips the tile to your guild. A loss still cracks a shield, so the next ally has a better chance.
Every battle plays out on a 3D island board: the Chog marches to the border, sparks fly, the roll sweeps, then VICTORY or DEFEATED with sound and animation.

FAIR PLAY
- Front lines: you can only hit tiles that touch your guild's land.
- Cooldowns: a captured tile locks for 30 minutes (core tiles for 1 hour).
- 5 energy per Chog per day, refilled at 00:00 UTC, so 5 minutes a day is enough to compete.
- Points come mostly from holding land, and repeat attacks on the same Chog within 24 hours earn nothing, so fake fights don't pay.
- Only the top 10 Chogs per wallet count for season rewards.

$CHOG ECONOMY
$CHOG is the only currency. Reinforce costs 50 $CHOG, extra energy 50, renaming a tile 35. Every spend goes on-chain into the ChogLand vault contract: 80% to the season pot, 15% to the weekly war pot and 5% to running the game. Prizes are paid from those pots by Merkle claim, so no new tokens are created.

SEASONS
A season lasts 4 weeks with a guild war every Tuesday at 18:00 UTC. At the end the map resets and a 24-hour land rush gives everyone a fair start: every Chog picks a starting tile in secret and all picks are revealed together.

WALLET BUILT IN
Sign up with a passkey in two taps, with no seed phrase to write down, or connect MetaMask or WalletConnect. The in-app wallet shows MON, $CHOG and your Chogs, sends and receives tokens and NFTs, and lets passkey users export their own recovery phrase on their device.

WHAT'S NEW
Most NFT games treat the NFT as a profile picture. In ChogLand the NFT is the unit, its traits are its team, and its battle history travels with it on the market.

title: Chog State
description:
Chog State turns every Chog NFT into a living cultural identity.

Most NFTs are born and then frozen. They stay the same picture forever. They never get to live. Chog State is different.

Chog was born from a failed AI experiment. Everyone still loved him. This project takes that origin seriously. You run risky experiments on a Chog. Most of them fail � and that is intentional. Every failure leaves a permanent scar on that specific token. The scars stack. The Weirdness score rises. The Chronicle grows. The Chog�s name and identity change over time.

When the NFT is sold, the entire history moves with it. The buyer does not just receive an image. They inherit the life the Chog has lived.

How it works:
� Pick an experiment and a risk level (Careful, Normal, or Reckless)
� Hold the button
� Most experiments fail and leave a visible scar
� Rare breakthroughs and milestones also get written into the Chronicle
� Every result shows the exact odds and the roll � nothing is hidden, no AI decides the outcome.

The Chog NFT is not a key that unlocks the experience. It is the experience itself.
Only the real owner can run experiments on a token. The history is stored against the token ID. Other apps can later read that history.

Demo Mode lets anyone try the full loop without a wallet. Real wallet mode writes the scars on-chain on Monad testnet.

We are nothing without our history.
Now neither is Chog.

This is Chog State.

title: FloorVault
description:
FloorVault is a memecoin launcher on Monad where every
  coin is paired with an NFT collection and eats its floor.

 Launch a coin on nad.fun in one transaction. Its trading
  creator fees flow into the FloorVault contract, which
  splits them: 80% becomes the coin's NFT budget, 10% goes
  to the coin's creator and 10% to the treasury.

  When the budget covers the collection's cheapest listing,
  an automated keeper buys that NFT. It is then raffled to
  the coin's holders, with a claim window and a re-raffle if
  the winner never claims.

  Browse coins in Explore, see the NFTs bought in the
  Gallery, and track each budget live. There is no indexer
  or database; the app reads the chain and nad.fun's API
  directly.

  Built for the CHOG NFT hackathon. Targets Monad mainnet
  (Chog Genesis) and testnet.

title: CHOG World Disorder
description:
CHOG World Disorder is a browser action game that turns CHOG NFTs into playable 3D characters, gameplay objectives, combat roles and persistent progression.

NFT traits influence what players do in a match, how they contribute to a team and which skills they can build.

FOUR PLAYABLE MODES

� Trait Hunt: A six-player pursuit where the carrier searches for the exact traits of a target NFT. Hunters compete to capture the carrier and take over the objective, inheriting collected traits.

� Boss Battle: Six CHOGs fight Hullbreaker across three phases. NFT traits determine Breaker, Guardian or Medic roles and contribute to the boss�s shield requirements. Damage, healing and protection contribute to raid performance.

� Trait Control: A 3v3 battle to capture and defend three stations. Players combine movement, weapons and their NFT-linked Workshop skills to control the map.

� Daily Trials: A solo beacon challenge with date-seeded rules and fixed equipment. Players compete against the same daily challenge rather than relying on NFT rarity.

NFT PROGRESSION AND SKILL WORKSHOP

My NFT displays Genesis artwork, metadata, trait frequencies and matching animated 3D characters. Equipped characters appear in gameplay, player portraits and reward reveals.

EXP and progression are tracked by collection address and token ID, allowing progression to follow the NFT when ownership changes.

Skill Workshop lets players combine an effect, target and modifier within a five-point budget. Trait requirements and boss victories unlock options, while cooldown and strength trade-offs constrain builds. Supported recipes and verified results can be saved through the onchain mode registry.

CHOG TOKEN INTEGRATION

Server-verified Trait Hunt matches settle rewards into a game balance. Withdrawals use signed, expiring vouchers and a funded reward vault.

The Boss Raid Pool lets players stake CHOG while keeping their NFT in their wallet. The operator funds a separate reward campaign, and raid contribution affects rewards. Principal and reward reserves remain separate. Displayed APR depends on campaign funding and total stake; it is not guaranteed external yield.

BUILT FOR BROWSER PLAY

The game includes five weapons, animated 3D environments, bots, private rooms with shareable codes, a tactical map with clickable Super Jumps, controller and touch support, and animated results with EXP and reward reveals.

TECHNICAL IMPLEMENTATION

A Three.js client handles rendering and input. A Node.js relay manages authenticated sessions, room lifecycle, match queues and isolated authoritative Chromium workers. The ledger tracks balances, withdrawals, NFT progression and records. Solidity contracts handle testnet assets, the reward vault, progression, raid pool and mode registry.

CURRENT DEMO

The blockchain integration runs on Monad testnet using Genesis replica NFTs and testCHOG. Mainnet NFTs and mainnet CHOG are not transferred. Guest practice is available without a wallet and does not create withdrawable rewards.

The public frontend is deployed on Vercel. Its active relay currently runs through a development tunnel, so availability depends on that service remaining online.

title: DUBU
description: Dubu brings your NFTs to life with AI. Upload an  nft image, describe what you want it to do, and turn it into a short video or GIF. Built for the Chog community on Monad, Dubu gives holders a new way to interact with their NFTs, create content, and share their characters with the world.

title: chogOS
description:
chogOS is an AI-run civilization governed by an autonomous AI mind, where every AI decision comes with a reason and a path to verification. Its Activity page at chogos.vercel.app/activity provides recorded events with verification links, backed by SHA-256 cryptographic hashes and Monad onchain transactions to establish a verifiable source of truth. Anyone can inspect the recorded reasoning, verify the integrity of event data, and independently confirm onchain actions, distinguishing what the AI decided, what the system recorded, and what was actually executed on the blockchain.

1. World 
The World tab shows what is happening inside the civilization and lets you observe life within chogOS. No individual user can control the civilization; the AI mind makes the decisions. Click any citizen to inspect their profile and personal information, or click any infrastructure or building to view its details.

2. Citizens
The Citizens tab shows the current citizens who have joined and are living inside the chogOS world, with detailed information about each citizen.

3. Economy
The Economy tab displays the civilization's resources, including ChogBank, its onchain treasury. The AI decides how treasury funds are spent, including paying citizens and funding other activities within the civilization.

4. History 
The History tab records activity happening throughout the world. Filter events by simulation, AI decisions, onchain activity, or system events. Each event includes a Verify link to check its integrity and, where applicable, inspect the corresponding onchain evidence.

 5. Verify

title: ChogBound
description:
ChogBound: your Chog. Your plan. Your fight.

WHAT IT IS ChogBound is a daily coaching and battle game for Chog Genesis NFTs on Monad. WHAT MAKES IT NEW

The traits are the rules. Every trait value on all 1,969 Chogs is mapped to game rules: 96 bodies, 58 eyes, 66 heads, 15 mouths, 22 auras, 9 accessories and 10 Legendary kits. Bodies and heads change stats, eyes give PUNCH and unlock a signature move (Laser Stare, Scan, Charm, Stare Down, Chaos Gaze), auras and accessories give fight effects (Scorch, Vanish, Calm Glow, Gust, Pump, Lucky Flip, Sidekick), the mouth sets the voice, and tier adds a stat bonus. A different Chog really does play a different game.
It is balanced on the whole collection, not on a sample. We simulated 2,000,000 random fights across all 1,969 Chogs. Token win rates stay between 34.6% and 68.0%, and win rate climbs with tier (about 48%, 52%, 60%, 61% and 64% from Common to Legendary). Rarity helps without deciding everything.
Everything is public and reproducible. The night number comes from the UTC date. A Chog's rival for a night is drawn by a public seeded draw, and every fight uses the seed night:youId:rivalId, so anyone can recompute any result or the whole standings. There is no hidden server state.
It sounds like a fighting game. Each move has its own wind-up, a hit is a crack, a slap and a thud, fighters shout before they strike, a miss is only a whiff, and the music ducks under big hits and gets more intense as health drops.

WHY CHOG MATTERS (THE NFT IS ESSENTIAL) Take the NFT out and there is no game. The Chog's traits are the characters, the stats, the special effects, the voices and the balance. Remove them and there is nothing to fight with.

Holders connect a wallet on Monad, sign a message (no transaction, no gas), and the game reads which Chogs that wallet owns directly from the Chog Genesis contract. Then they coach one of their own Chogs with its real traits.
Every night's draw and the standings cover the whole Chog collection, so each Chog has its own record.
Guest mode lets reviewers try the game without a wallet. It borrows 24 sample Chogs and uses the same real trait data and the same fight engine. It is a trial so anyone can see what a Chog does, and the full experience is playing your own.

WHY PEOPLE COME BACK A new night starts every day at 00:00 UTC with a new rival for every Chog, so there is always a new fight to coach. The arena shows your Chog's rank among 1,969, your record, tonight's rival and a countdown to the next night.

HOW IT WORKS UNDER THE HOOD

TypeScript monorepo. A deterministic fight engine (sim/) with its own test suite and balance tools, and a Next.js 15 app (web/).
viem reads the Chog Genesis contract on Monad mainnet (chain 143). The contract is not enumerable, so ownership is read with Multicall3: all 1,969 owners in 5 requests (about 2 seconds, measured).
Chog art is never stored. Images load in the player's browser from public IPFS gateways, with a drawn placeholder if none answer.
Quality: 99 unit tests, 38 browser tests (Playwright, with a simulated wallet and a simulated Monad node) and CI on every push.

WHAT IS NOT BUILT YET No contract is deployed by this project. On-chain nightly records, ERC-6551 token-bound accounts, a Farcaster Mini App and signed player plans that enter the public standings are planned and listed in docs/ROADMAP.md. The standings use autopilot plans for every Chog so that anyone can reproduce them.

title: Dybbo
description:
Dybbo: possess any Chog for a few minutes and pay the holder.


There are 1,969 Chog Genesis and about 982 people who own one. Monad has more than 4.3 million wallets. The difference is the audience almost every Chog app leaves out. Open a holder-gated Chog game without a Chog and you get a guest mode, a practice mode, a "simulated judge" column. You watch. Someone else plays.


The obvious fix is to let holders lend. But Chog Genesis has no rental role, so lending means sending the NFT to an escrow, wrapping it, or signing setApprovalForAll, which hands a contract the power to move every NFT in the wallet. That power is where NFTs go missing. reNFT renters could hijack rented tokens during the handoff (Code4rena 2024, issue #588). In one 2026 sweep, a single forgotten approval let one wallet take 25,994 NFTs from 3,033 wallets. Holders are right to say no.


So we asked a narrower question. Can someone without a Chog really control one for a while, without the holder giving up anything at all?


WHAT DYBBO DOES

Pick any Chog, pay its price per minute (0.01 MON by default) for 1 to 10 minutes, and you act as it. The whole fee drops into that Chog's escrow. The NFT never moves. A possession is only a record inside the Dybbo contract: who, which Chog, until when, and who owned it when the lease began.

While the timer runs, you haunt. Leave Boo, Slime or Hex on another Chog and the mark sits beside its art on its public page for a day, signed "by #1462, possessed". One haunt every 15 seconds, one per target per day, eight live marks per Chog. The Chog's metadata and image never change.

Holders don't need a lease to haunt with their own Chogs, so a haunted holder can strike back. Holders never sign up either: every Chog in a wallet is open from the first block and earns by default. Whoever holds the Chog when they claim takes its escrow. They can set their own price or close their Chog.


HOW IT HOLDS

The contract touches Chog Genesis in exactly one way: it reads ownerOf. There is no code path to approve or transfer, and a test scans the deployed bytecode for any approve or transfer selector and finds none.

Each haunt re-reads ownerOf inside the same transaction. A lease is live only while the clock hasn't run out and the Chog still belongs to whoever owned it when the lease began. Control ends in the block the lease expires (LeaseExpired) or the block the Chog changes hands (OwnerChanged). No server checks anything later, and nothing needs revoking.

Escrow is keyed to the token, not to a person, and pays only the current ownerOf. Sell your Chog and the buyer can claim what it earned before the sale. The token page says so before anyone buys.

Two edge cases shaped the rules. Chogs held by contracts start closed, because a lending vault could let someone borrow a Chog for one block just to drain its escrow, the trick that once claimed 60,564 APE with five borrowed apes. Smart-account (EIP-7702) wallets count as normal wallets, which keeps 1,968 of the 1,969 Chogs open on day one. And there is no admin: no owner, no pause, no upgrade, no protocol fee, no function that can touch escrowed MON.


DON'T TRUST US, RUN IT

During a possession, press "Try to take it". The app asks the real Chog Genesis contract to move the Chog to you, and it refuses: ERC721InsufficientApproval. Beside the refusal sit the approval reads: approved for all is false, the approved address is empty. Wait out the timer and "Try one more haunt" reverts with LeaseExpired. The /proof page runs all three checks as free simulations against mainnet.


WHAT'S NEW

Every way to lend an NFT today gives a contract power to move it. Dybbo lends control without handing over any power. The possessor gets a role inside Dybbo, enforced by Dybbo, and the Chog never leaves its holder's wallet. Ownership is checked on chain at every action, not by a server on a timer. The collection is open by default, so nobody has to list anything. Fees belong to the token and follow it through sales.

It needs Monad to work. Every haunt is its own transaction with ownerOf read inside it, and with 300 ms blocks and sub-cent fees, a sale or an expiry takes effect on the very next block. On a slower, pricier chain, the practical design is a server that re-checks ownership now and then, which is the exact weakness Dybbo exists to avoid.


A THIRD WAY TO HOLD AN NFT

You can own an NFT or look at one. Dybbo adds a third option: be one, briefly. A mark signed "by #1462, possessed" is a public act by a Chog someone else owns, paid for in advance, with the holder's consent built in by default. A Chog earns while it sits in a wallet, with no listing. And because a live lease is public on chain (leaseOf), any holder-gated Chog game could let a possessor play "as this Chog" instead of benching them in spectator mode.


WHY IT HAS TO BE CHOG

Pull the NFT out and nothing is left. The Chog is the body being possessed. It is the payee, since escrow is keyed to its token ID and only its current owner can claim. It is the off switch, since the lease dies the moment ownerOf changes. And Chog's own lore is a curious, mischievous kid who causes chaos. Dybbo hands that role to anyone for a few minutes.


WHY PEOPLE COME BACK

Getting haunted is a reason to return. The mark names the Chog that left it, and answering costs only gas. Marks expire after 24 hours, so staying haunted, or having the last word, means coming back. Fees keep piling up for holders until they claim. Leases are short enough to do again with another Chog, and a possessor can run several at once. During Chogtober, one possession night leaves the collection visibly haunted the next day.

We won't call retention proven. The contract went live on 2026-10-22, and its counters (possessions, haunts, distinct possessors, fees paid and claimed) are public through stats(). That is how we'll know.


TRY IT

No Chog needed. https://dybbo.vercel.app/judges walks through the full loop with about 0.1 MON.

title: Chogsweeper

# Chogsweeper

Pick a Chog. Today it's a minesweeper board, and it plays differently from every other Chog's board.

3. Tap a tile to open it. Right-click to flag, or use Flag mode on a phone.

## How a Chog becomes the board

The token number and today's date set the mines, so a Chog's board is the same for everyone that day. Then four traits change the rules. Tier sets the size, from Common at 8 by 8 with 10 mines up to Legendary at 14 by 14 with 30. Eyes give a free safe peek (939 of 1,969 Chogs). A solid hat, cap or helmet takes one hit for you (1,147). Any accessory flags one real mine for you (195).

Just after midnight UTC the site posts a fingerprint of the day's secret on Monad. A fingerprint is a short code that matches one secret and no other. When the day ends the secret is published, and anyone can open /verify, pick a past day and any Chog, and watch the page rebuild that board and check it against the fingerprint. - The reveal wall at /wall, filling in with art as Chogs get cleared.

## Not proven yet

Built with Monad mainnet, Chog Genesis, $CHOG, Next.js, viem, Upstash Redis and Vercel. The board engine started from my earlier game ghostsweeper (https://github.com/Sireadell/ghostsweeper).

title: Chog Pet
description:
Chog Pet turns each of the 1,969 Chog Genesis NFTs into a living pixel pet.

Every Chog is ONE shared pet. Its holder is its home, but anyone can open any Chog and babysit it. Food, fun, energy and clean run down in real time. Leave a Chog alone too long and it gets sad, then wanders off looking for snacks until someone feeds it back home.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Find any Chog by number, roll a random one, or browse Chogtown: tabs for "Need you", "New homes" and "Happy".
- Care for it on a pixel handheld: FEED (its favourite food has a star), PLAY Candle Catch on its screen, BATH, LIGHTS to tuck it in. Each act has a short cooldown, so care is a habit, not a click race.
- Watch the town follow your Chog: the Orbit city ring is day while it is awake and night while it sleeps, with walkers, a blimp and balloons. Fling the city and it coasts to a stop.
- Earn Candles and XP for every kind act and level up as a sitter. Three quests a day ("Today") pay extra.
- Candles hub: Daily (one wheel spin a day, a streak), Games (Capsules, Green or Red, Candle Catch), Shop (snacks and room gifts), Level.
- Reach the town's daily goal together and it's Festival day: fireworks over Chogtown and a sticker for every Chog cared for that day.
- Talk in the town chat, collect stickers, share a card of your Chog on X.

FOR HOLDERS
The holder is read live from the Chog Genesis contract on Monad (ownerOf). Holders name their Chog, earn 1.5x XP caring for it at home, grow a bond from Friend to Best friend to Soulmate, and get a "Welcome home" note listing who looked after their Chog while they were away. When a Chog is sold, its old life goes into "past homes" and it starts fresh with the new holder. Wallets that hold the $CHOG token unlock a special $CHOG treat for any Chog (a balance check, no transaction).

FAIR BY DESIGN
Rewards are capped and server-side: per-day XP and Candles caps, diminishing returns per Chog, one wheel spin per network per day, cooldowns shared per network, signed game tickets so a score must fit the time played, and a chat filter against impersonation. Everyone starts at level 1.

A wallet is optional: you can play right away as an anonymous sitter, with progress kept in the browser. Sign-in goes through Privy: connect a wallet or log in with X, Google or email, and Privy creates a wallet for you. Sign-in is a free signature, no transaction and no gas, and it carries your progress over. Nothing is bought or sent on-chain.

title: Chog-noir
description:
Every night something real happens to Chogs on Monad. Every morning your Chog takes the case. One witness is lying. The chain never does.

Chog Noir is a daily detective game built from real Chog activity. Today's case starts with a real sale, transfer, or escrow deal on Monad. The witnesses are real Chogs connected to that event. One gives a false statement about its own history. You catch it by pairing the statement with the transaction receipt that proves it wrong.

How a case works

1. Connect the wallet holding your Chog with one signature and no gas.
2. Pick your Chog as the detective.
3. Read three witness statements. Press a witness for more detail or present a receipt against a statement.
4. A correct receipt triggers CAUGHT and unlocks the next part of the case.
5. Reconstruct what happened with phrase tiles, then open the reveal and check every fact on Monadscan.

A case takes about three minutes. Weekday cases have one lying Chog. Weekend cases have two.

Your Chog changes the investigation

The NFT is the detective, not a profile picture beside the game. Its traits choose its skill. Laser eyes can open sealed evidence, glasses help narrow the receipt list, and other eye traits give different advantages. How long you have held the Chog sets your question budget. A witness may also talk more freely if it shares a rare trait, wallet history, or mint connection with your detective.

The record belongs to the token ID. Cases solved, rank, streak, and caught liars stay with the Chog when it changes owners. A wallet without a Chog can play the same live case at the Rookie desk, but that borrowed badge keeps no record.

The mystery is real and checkable

The game does not invent its cases. It reads Chog Genesis activity from Monad, classifies the events, builds the statements and receipts, and rejects any case its solver cannot complete with every detective skill. The server decides every catch and never sends the answer to the browser while a case is open.

Before play begins, a hash of the answer key is written to the CaseBook contract. After the case closes, the full key is revealed on-chain. The Verify page rebuilds the commitment from public data and reports whether it matches. Every receipt also links to its transaction, block, and log entry.

$CHOG has two uses. It appears as evidence in cases built from real deals paid in $CHOG. A player may also burn 100 $CHOG for one extra question, up to twice in a case. The burn is checked on-chain and does not add points. Nothing is paid out to players.

Live on Monad mainnet

Chog Noir has been running on Monad mainnet since 22 October 2026. The system tracks 5,130 Chog Genesis transfers across all 1,969 tokens and 2,302 wallets, then follows new blocks as they arrive.

title: ChogSekai
description:
Be the god in their story.

ChogSekai is an isekai god-sim where all 1,969 Chog Genesis NFTs live at once as AI agents on a 3D fantasy continent called Monadia. Every Chog has a name, a house, a personality, a job and a life. Players are Constellations: gods who cannot command anyone, only nudge their own Chogs with skills, quests and blessings, then watch what the world does with it.

Try it out right now!
Game: chogsekai.vercel.app

How a season works

Each season every Chog is summoned with a new job (36 in all: baker, blacksmith, guard, scribe, farmer, plus adventurer roles: main DPS, sub DPS, tank, healer, support, buffer).
A Demon King and his generals awaken. Parties form, dungeons open, and the season ends when a Hero emerges and lands the final blow.
The world ticks every 10 minutes and a season lasts about 24 hours, so there is always something new to come back to.
What you do as a god (Star Pulls) You get 5 Star Pulls per season, one rising every ~4.8 hours. Each pull shows 4 cards (2 skills, 2 quests); you choose 1 and bestow it on a Chog you hold. It lands on the next tick and shows up in that Chog's story. It is a small, real decision, and it is the thing that brings holders back through the day.

The NFT is essential, not decoration

Star Pulls and blessings are gated by on-chain ownership: you connect a wallet, sign a message, and the server checks on Monad which Chogs you hold.
Each NFT's art and traits shape its agent: house colour, personality, starting stats, and the life story that is written about it.
Every one of the 1,969 tokens is a living character in the same shared world, so every holder is a part of the same story.
Stories that never read the same twice A deterministic story-graph engine (no model calls, so it is cheap, fast and reproducible) writes:

the Chronicle: a short novel per season, drawn from 8 premises (a lantern in the dark, the returner, the overlord, the slime, the shield, the gate, the misfits, the hidden one), built from 191 story beats
a Life Story for every Chog, with their past lives, relationships and turning points (71 life nodes)
a live Star Stream narrating the world as it happens (35 event kinds, 239 lines) A season never repeats one of the last three premises.
Criteria

Novelty: NFTs as living agents in a god-sim, with a new novel every season.
Fun: pick one of four cards, then read what became of it.
Retention: timed pulls, a 24-hour season arc, and a Chronicle that changes every day.
Clarity: one-sentence pitch (nudge your Chogs, read their story), plays in the browser with no install.
Execution: live at the app link, ticking on its own around the clock.
Status and honesty notes

Playable in desktop Chrome (WebGL2). First load takes 30 to 40 seconds (about 40 MB of WebAssembly).
Wallet sign-in and the Monad ownership check are implemented. A real holder wallet has been tested by us only through the judge code (see judge instructions), not yet with an outside holder.
We have no outside player feedback yet.
1,962 of the 1,969 Chogs have loadable metadata and are currently summoned.
